id.description: The actor's id (stable across renames; blocking/steps.yaml refers to it)

name.description: Name, as shown in Kloarte and printed on the shirt

female.description: true = a woman mannequin (missing = a man)

shirtColor.description: Shirt colour "#rrggbb"; missing = a colour from the palette

height.description: Height; missing = the default for a man / woman (m)

initial.description: Where and how the actor is before the first cue

delay.description: Wait before this step starts, after GO or the previous step (s)

moveTime.description: Time to walk to this step's position; missing = walking speed (s)

visible.description: On stage (false = off stage, not drawn)

position.description: Position [x, y, z] in stage coordinates (x to the audience's right, y up, z towards the audience) (m)

facing.description: Facing, around the vertical: 0 = towards the audience (°)
